name: novelwriter
description: Personal novel writing studio with AI assistance (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Ollama)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "bun run --cwd server dev" "bun run --cwd client dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd client build && bun run --cwd server build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd client typecheck
